name: Shatter

header.Components: V, S, M (a chip of mica)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Point-origin 10-foot sphere; CON-half Thunder, Constructs save at Disadvantage; eligible nonmagical unattended objects in sphere take full damage without save, including creature-collocated objects.

rules.text: A loud noise erupts from a point of your choice within range.
Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
A Construct has Disadvantage on the save.
A nonmagical object that isn’t being worn or carried also takes the damage if it’s in the spell’s area.
The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.
